# has trajectory sample

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasTrajectorySample`](gmeow-hasTrajectorySample.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasTrajectorySample>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A discrete location-state sample composing this trajectory. Non-functional: a trajectory typically has many samples, and multiple sampling strategies (e.g. GPS every second vs. radar every minute) may coexist for the same trajectory ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Trajectory`](../classes/gmeow-Trajectory.md) -> [`gmeow:LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasTrajectorySample`](gmeow-hasTrajectorySample.md) from [`gmeow:Trajectory`](../classes/gmeow-Trajectory.md) to [`gmeow:LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
